# When the Bottleneck Shifts: Diagnosing and Closing Information Gaps in Interactive Text-to-SQL

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#pascal)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-09**

[Original source](https://aclanthology.org/2026.emnlp-main.465.pdf) · EMNLP 2026 proceedings, pages 10655-10687

**Reading coverage:** All 33 PDF pages: Sections 1-6, limitations, Appendices A-I, algorithms, sufficiency extraction, all six detailed SQL/trajectory case studies, robustness controls and PRACTIQ comparison. Visually checked PDF pages 30 and 32 for cost and efficiency figures.

## Research question

Interactive SQL agents can spend scarce environment calls generating queries before obtaining necessary schema, business rules or user intent.

## Method

PASCAL uses training-free source-aware acquisition gates, schema injection, typed knowledge retrieval, informed clarification, bounded retries and follow-up state carry. A gold-derived coverage score diagnoses missing evidence after execution; it is not a runtime oracle.

## Evaluation

A local Qwen3.6-35B backbone is evaluated on BIRD-Interact Lite/Full, with additive ablations, schema-matched controls and 100-task simulator, budget and retry sensitivity experiments. PRACTIQ evaluation uses a 1,069-task subset and an explicit abstention path.

## What the results support

The paper reports 51.0% first-phase and 37.0% cumulative two-phase success on Lite, with larger gains on knowledge-intensive queries. Controls support a benefit beyond initial schema access; delayed clarification still creates regressions. Three subset runs yield 54, 54 and 53 percent first-phase success.

## Limits and qualifications

Coverage is partly constructed from submitted SQL mentions and gold annotations, not independent semantic understanding. Cost totals and detailed trajectories conflict with stated budgets, and value-diff case studies are not reconciled with the no-value-diff result setting. PRACTIQ abstention and prior post-clarification SQL scores require protocol qualification.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

Offers concrete acquisition-control mechanisms and diagnostics; numerical efficiency and leaderboard-equivalence claims need clarification before reuse.
